subject: general
question: What sum of money invested at 8% per annum in 1(1)/(2) years, componnded half-yearly, shall become Rs. 17,576 ?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ?

Rate (R) = 8% per annum compounded half-yearly

Time (T) = 1(1)/(2) years = 3 half-years

Amount (A) = Rs. 17,576

**Formula Used:**

(A = P (1 + (R)/(100n))ⁿt)

**Calculation:**

Given, R = 8% per annum, compounded half-yearly ⇒ R/2 = 4% per half-year

T = 1.5 year
